can i borrow books: Yes, absolutely! All currently enrolled JRMSU students with a valid ID can borrow books.

how many books can i borrow: Generally, undergraduate students can borrow up to 3 books at a time. Please consult the librarian for specific limits based on your course.

how long can i borrow a book: Circulation books can usually be borrowed for 3 days and may be renewed if no one else has reserved them.

what is the penalty for late books: Overdue books incur a fine per day. Please return your books on time to avoid penalties and allow other students to use them.

can i renew my borrowed books: Yes, you can renew a book if it hasn't been reserved by another student. Bring the book to the desk before it's overdue.

what is the dress code: Please observe the university's standard dress code when entering the library. Sleeveless shirts, shorts, and slippers might not be allowed.
